methodology.primary_reference: Earliest timestamped prospective snapshot for each game.

methodology.model_error: Actual home margin minus Model A projected home margin.
methodology.market_error: Actual home margin minus market-implied home margin at snapshot.
methodology.ats_result: Result for the model-preferred side using the market spread captured in that prospective snapshot.
methodology.closing_line: Near-kickoff closing proxy, not asserted to be the canonical close.
